title: Twelve Stones from the Jordan

questions.question: What were the twelve men commanded to take from the Jordan?
questions.explanation: Joshua 4:3 (ESV): "Take twelve stones from here out of the midst of the Jordan..."

questions.question: Where were these stones taken from specifically?
options: From the very place where the priests' feet stood firmly
questions.correctAnswer: From the very place where the priests' feet stood firmly
questions.explanation: Joshua 4:3 (ESV): "...from the very place where the priests' feet stood firmly..."

questions.question: What was the purpose of these stones?
options: To be a sign and a memorial to the people of Israel forever
To build an altar for sacrifice
questions.correctAnswer: To be a sign and a memorial to the people of Israel forever
questions.explanation: Joshua 4:6-7 (ESV): "that this may be a sign among you... these stones shall be to the people of Israel a memorial forever."

questions.question: Where did they set up the twelve stones?
questions.explanation: Joshua 4:20 (ESV): "And those twelve stones, which they took out of the Jordan, Joshua set up at Gilgal."

questions.question: When did the waters of the Jordan return to their place?
options: When the soles of the priests' feet were lifted up to dry land
questions.correctAnswer: When the soles of the priests' feet were lifted up to dry land
questions.explanation: Joshua 4:18 (ESV): "...and when the soles of the priests' feet were lifted up on dry ground, the waters of the Jordan returned..."

questions.question: Did Joshua set up any other stones?
options: Yes, twelve stones in the midst of the Jordan
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, twelve stones in the midst of the Jordan
questions.explanation: Joshua 4:9 (ESV): "And Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of the Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests... stood..."

questions.question: How many armed men from Reuben, Gad, and Manasseh crossed over?
questions.explanation: Joshua 4:13 (ESV): "About 40,000 ready for war passed over before the Lord..."

questions.question: On what day did the people come up out of the Jordan?
options: The tenth day of the first month
The first day of the year
questions.correctAnswer: The tenth day of the first month
questions.explanation: Joshua 4:19 (ESV): "The people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth day of the first month..."

questions.question: What are the children to ask in time to come?
options: "What do these stones mean to you?"
questions.correctAnswer: "What do these stones mean to you?"
questions.explanation: Joshua 4:6 (ESV): "When your children ask in time to come, 'What do those stones mean to you?'"

questions.question: Where is Gilgal located relative to Jericho?
options: On the east border of Jericho
questions.correctAnswer: On the east border of Jericho
questions.explanation: Joshua 4:19 (ESV): "...and they encamped at Gilgal on the east border of Jericho."

questions.question: Why did the Lord dry up the Jordan, according to Joshua?
options: So that all the peoples of the earth may know the hand of the Lord is mighty
questions.correctAnswer: So that all the peoples of the earth may know the hand of the Lord is mighty
questions.explanation: Joshua 4:24 (ESV): "so that all the peoples of the earth may know that the hand of the Lord is mighty..."

questions.question: The crossing of the Jordan is compared to what previous event in verse 23?
options: The drying up of the Red Sea
questions.correctAnswer: The drying up of the Red Sea
questions.explanation: Joshua 4:23 (ESV): "For the Lord your God dried up the waters of the Jordan... as the Lord your God did to the Red Sea..."

questions.question: What effect did this event have on Joshua's reputation?
options: The Lord exalted Joshua in the sight of all Israel, and they stood in awe of him as they had of Moses
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord exalted Joshua in the sight of all Israel, and they stood in awe of him as they had of Moses
questions.explanation: Joshua 4:14 (ESV): "On that day the Lord exalted Joshua in the sight of all Israel..."

questions.question: Who commanded Joshua to tell the priests to come up out of the Jordan?
questions.explanation: Joshua 4:15 (ESV): "And the Lord said to Joshua, 'Command the priests... to come up out of the Jordan.'"

questions.question: What specific location in the riverbed were the stones taken from?
options: Where the priests' feet stood firmly
questions.correctAnswer: Where the priests' feet stood firmly
questions.explanation: Joshua 4:3 (ESV): "...from the very place where the priests' feet stood firmly..."

key_verse_text: ...so that all the peoples of the earth may know that the hand of the LORD is mighty, that you may fear the LORD your God forever. (ESV)
